method: requirements-check-1 (Sonnet 5 judge + Sonnet 5 check; disagreements unknown; quotes verified)

evidence.quote: This Zotero plugin addresses the pain when you store papers from arXiv and want to update your Zotero entry when they are published.

checkNote: It calls keyless scholarly APIs (arXiv, Semantic Scholar, dblp, PubMed); the pack says 'Where its code keeps a key, token or password: none found', and a code grep for api-key headers found nothing. It has no AI features.
